content.comment_body: I'm using [version_no] and a [article_no] module. I created a simple test program in ladder, uploaded it, and then attempted an online test. The system reports the programs are different. Is online testing only available in function block diagrams?

Although I have a [article_no] module and [product_name] [version_no], that shouldn't make a difference. A program created in ladder can also be monitored online without issues. If parameter values are changed in the controller, for example when modifying an arithmetic instruction by the inputs, and online monitoring is attempted afterward, a message appears stating the programs differ. This occurs in both ladder and function block modes. To observe online, download the program from the controller to the PC then convert it to ladder. Start online monitoring from there. As long as online mode is active, parameter changes on the controller can be observed without further program difference errors.
Have you selected the correct hardware? Go to Tools > Select Hardware > [product_name] [article_no] Standard or ES3 or Upd 2. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you! I'm new to [company_name] [product_name], and I missed that step. It is working now.

analysis.insight_summary: Initially, users encountered confusion about whether online monitoring in the software was limited to function block diagrams when working with specific modules. Other users clarified that online monitoring is available in ladder logic, but program mismatches can occur if certain parameters are modified directly in the controller. The root cause of the issue was improper hardware selection in the software, and once corrected, the initial user resolved the problem. This exchange demonstrates the learning process for new users around proper hardware setup and understanding system notifications regarding mismatches.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect online monitoring to function properly in ladder diagram mode, without special limitations based on diagram type. Clear guidance and precise error messages regarding hardware configuration and parameter differences are also anticipated.
